description:
Replace the current 'in-flight conversations' bullet list with
visual badges per branch in the git_tree render, and add a pulsing
indicator on steps whose tool calls are mid-flight.

=== Scope ===

1. Branch-state classifier (pure function over GitTree shape, no
   egui dep): given a ConversationBranch, return one of {in_flight,
   merged, stopped, conflicted}.
   - merged: the conversation merge commit is on main's first-parent
     trunk (already detected in git_tree).
   - in_flight: unmerged ref under refs/heads/ AND its tip
     timestamp is within a recent freshness window (default 60s,
     configurable in tests).
   - stopped: unmerged AND tip timestamp older than the freshness
     window. No active lernie process touching it.
   - conflicted: a worktree exists under <conv-repo>/<descent>/
     with an unresolved merge state (.git/MERGE_HEAD or similar).
     Detected via a lightweight git status --porcelain check.
   Tests cover each classification against fixture repos.

2. Tool-call pulse detection (pure function over fs state): a tool
   call is in-flight when steps/<conv-id>/<NNN>/tools/<tool-id>/
   has input.json but no output.json, per ARCH §3.3. The
   classifier returns the set of in-flight (step, tool-id) pairs
   for a given conv-repo.

3. egui rendering of badges + pulse: state badges next to each
   branch label, color-keyed. Pulse animation (egui's
   ctx.request_repaint_after) on the step row matching an
   in-flight tool call. The animation logic stays in the egui
   widget; the classification stays pure.

=== Constraints ===

- Classification is pure (filesystem snapshot in, label out).
  Pixel rendering is the only egui-dep code path.
- Detection mechanism is filesystem state per ARCH §3.5; no
  process-table polling, no sidecar marker files.
- Stopped is provisional in v0.5 — a 'stopped' branch may resume
  later. v0.6's workflow state machine (lernie resume) will pin
  the real terminal vs paused distinction.

=== Gates ===

Tests, docs, alignment per AGENTS.md.
title: v0.5 Phase 8: branch-state badges + tool-call pulse indicators
